name: Capers
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated on SIBO diets as they're naturally low FODMAP and used in small quantities.
preparationTips: Rinse salted capers before use to reduce sodium content
Pat dry after rinsing for better texture in dishes
Add at the end of cooking to preserve their tangy flavor
Store in refrigerator after opening and use brine to keep fresh
nutritionalHighlights: Low in calories (only 2 calories per tablespoon)
Contains antioxidants like quercetin and rutin
Provides small amounts of iron and copper
